decision: Commit agent-inbox refactor immediately as top priority
rationale: 348 uncommitted files (257 untracked) with 45K+ lines changed. Disk failure or accidental git clean would destroy substantial work. Both intelligence-officer and operations-chief flagged this as CRITICAL risk.

decision: Shift investment ratio to 70/30 in favor of core execution loop over linear-return features
rationale: Strategist analysis shows compound returns from agent-manager + prompt-manager + workspace-sandbox pipeline improvements vs linear returns from UX features like TTS. The recursive improvement loop is Vrooli's differentiator and should receive majority investment.

decision: Adopt Now/Near/Far priority framework: NOW=stabilize+commit, NEAR=revenue+ecosystem, FAR=autonomous loop+marketplace
rationale: Synthesized from intelligence briefing (current state), operations assessment (build health), and strategic analysis (portfolio + dependencies). This framework balances risk mitigation, compound returns, and revenue generation.

decision: Reaffirm 70/30 core-loop investment ratio with explicit enforcement
rationale: Last 30 commits show ~30/70 ratio (inverted). TTS consumed 16 commits while core loop got 7. New work (self-healing sandboxes, screen recording) correctly targets compound returns. Must redirect bandwidth: no new TTS/voice work until prompt-manager shared team state and agent-manager stabilization complete.

decision: Investigate and fix scenario-dependency-analyzer health before next heartbeat
rationale: Unhealthy for 7h. Dependency analysis is foundational for portfolio management and automated scenario discovery. Operations-chief flagged as HIGH priority.

decision: Commit swarm-manager and tidiness-manager uncommitted work in logical chunks
rationale: 28 modified + 11 untracked files. While not critical (down from 348), maintaining low uncommitted file counts prevents risk reaccumulation. Both scenarios have active development that should be preserved.

decision: Adopt WIP limit of 3 active scenarios + finish-first rule to enforce 70/30 ratio
rationale: Two previous 70/30 decisions were violated (30% actual vs 70% target). Decisions without enforcement are theater. WIP limit (max 3 active scenarios: prompt-manager, agent-manager, ONE other) combined with finish-first rule (no new scenario work until current milestone ships) provides structural enforcement. This addresses the decision-execution gap identified as our #1 strategic risk.

decision: Commit tunnel-manager refactor as top priority this heartbeat — 74 uncommitted files at risk
rationale: Tunnel-manager has a ~90% complete architectural refactor with 7,655 lines deleted and 61 new files. This is the single largest uncommitted change set. Previous decision to keep uncommitted file count low is being violated (104 files, up from 39). Must commit in logical chunks before any other work.

decision: Active scenario focus for next 2 weeks: (1) prompt-manager needs-based dev, (2) agent-manager stabilization, (3) tunnel-manager completion. All other scenario work PAUSED.
rationale: Breadth-without-depth risk: last 30 commits touch 10+ scenarios, none reaching completion. Compound value only materializes when scenarios are DONE. These 3 are chosen because prompt-manager enables team coordination (compound), agent-manager is the execution engine (compound), and tunnel-manager has massive uncommitted work that must land (risk mitigation).

rationale: questdb unhealthy for 28h may affect scenarios depending on time-series data. whisper unhealthy for 28h blocks any speech-related work. scenario-dependency-analyzer returning 503 on analysis endpoint since restart. None are blocking core work but represent accumulating technical debt.
